## Day 3 IaC review

- [ ] No cloud credential, state, raw plan or secret is included.
- [ ] Saved-plan checksum and sanitized summary are attached.
- [ ] Create/change/destroy counts and IAM/network/data risk reviewed.
- [ ] Cost estimate is within approved lab budget.
- [ ] No unexpected destroy or unresolved unknown value.
- [ ] Human reviewer approved protected Environment before any apply.
